question: Would Bayern Munich win the 2026 Franz Beckenbauer Supercup match against Borussia Dortmund (Aug 22, 2026), based on the result at the end of regulation time (90 minutes + added time)?

model.prompt_context:

- "No": Wins if Borussia Dortmund's final score is strictly greater than Bayern Munich's at the end of the match (90 minutes plus any added time), meaning Borussia Dortmund wins the match outright in regular time.
- "Draw": Wins if both sides have an equal score at the end of regular time (90 minutes plus any added time), regardless of any subsequent extra time or penalty shootout result.

- This market resolves on the result at the end of regulation time (90 minutes plus referee-added time) only; any extra time or penalty shootout used to determine a cup winner does not affect resolution.
